[SWS_CM_00070] Transmission of Non-Time-Synchronous Control Format mes-
sages
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00006, RS_CM_00004
⌈
If an
IEEE1722 ACF stream
message is triggered for transmission and the at-
tribute
IEEE1722TpAcfConnection.acfMaxTransitTime
is not defined, then
the
IEEE1722 ACF stream
message shall be sent according to the "Non-Time-
Synchronous Control Format" of [20].
⌋
